reviews.text: A huge thank you to Théo for his help! I highly recommend him. Over the course of our sessions, I learned to understand my dog ​​better, and our bond has grown even stronger. I'm thrilled.
Availability, personalized advice – perfect for progressing as a team! The dog and the owner!

Excellent support, I highly recommend it. We opted for a package of 5 sessions for our 18-month-old beagle/Labrador mix, who, among other things, is reactive towards other dogs. We were able to gradually work on the basics (giving up, managing emotions, managing frustration, recall, etc.) and challenging situations. The situation has improved significantly. Our dog, and especially we, have made a lot of progress: we left with plenty of tips and tricks to apply for the rest of the training; we are better able to understand our dog, analyze his reactions, and adjust our behavior. Théo is very attentive to the dog and especially to the owner ;). He demonstrated great patience, kindness, and adaptability in guiding us without judgment. Thank you again, Théo, and don't hesitate to contact him.
We contacted Théo to help with our dog's separation anxiety. He also helped us a lot with other training issues. I highly recommend him!
I can now enjoy more peaceful walks with my little chihuahua. A big thank you for the result.

We hired Théo to train our 5-year-old Belgian Malinois, and we are absolutely delighted with the results.

From the very beginning, he proved to be highly professional, attentive, and a great teacher. He didn't just work with our dog; he also helped us understand him better, which made all the difference.
Over the course of the sessions, we saw real progress. Our dog improved tremendously thanks to his advice and his method. You can immediately tell that Théo knows his stuff and is passionate about what he does.
Honestly, we have nothing but praise. If you're hesitating to contact him, don't: go for it without hesitation!

Fantastic experience with Theo, who guided us through my dog's first year. He helped us master basic commands and provided personalized support and advice during his classes. My dog ​​adores him 💟
Thank you so much! …

Excellent teaching, attentive and responsive to needs, working on specific points according to the difficulties of the owner or the dog.

I've seen real progress in the ways I've been asking for help, and a sense of relief regarding my anxieties about the future for my dog.

I will continue everything we've worked on together during the lessons and enjoy every moment with Astrid.

Thank you again for everything.

Théo is a fantastic trainer. I contacted him without any specific behavioral concerns, simply to strengthen my bond with my dog ​​and help him progress in various areas. I've been working with Théo on this for a few months now. In my opinion, his training approach combines great kindness, keen behavioral analysis, and a pragmatic learning method. I highly recommend him!

When you know you've made the right choice!!!

A very serious and professional dog trainer who uses a positive reinforcement method and also specializes in rehabilitating dogs who have suffered trauma...
Second lesson today and huge progress in desensitizing my Frenchie 🙏
Exemplary teaching methods, gentle, non-judgmental, with very relevant analysis, and as a result, a connection with my dog, who is very fearful, that lives up to my expectations.
Flocon is totally on board, and so am I!
Thank you, Theo!
I highly recommend him; you won't be disappointed!! On the contrary, you'll get tailored solutions for the well-being of your dog and yourself as their owner 🙏

I wholeheartedly recommend Théo's services. We opted for the 8-session package for Aloa, from when she was 5 to 9 months old, and it was incredibly helpful, both for her and for us. 😇 We learned lots of useful commands like recall and shipping, but also reinforced some basics and got advice on daily life with a puppy and a cat to make things go as smoothly as possible. He's a trainer with excellent advice! We highly recommend him! 🐾

We contacted Théo to help our dog overcome his fears in the city and better manage his emotions. From the very first sessions, we saw real progress. His approach is gentle, respectful, and highly professional. His advice is clear and tailored, without judgment. Today, our dog is more confident, and walks are much more peaceful. I highly recommend him!

After several sessions with Théo, we've noticed an improvement in our dogs' behavior.

Thank you for the great advice! Now we just need to keep it all in mind and continue putting everything we've learned into practice!

Thanks again 😊
D&E

Théo is an excellent dog trainer, friendly and always available.

We learned a lot from him, and our little Jack Russell is very easy to live with now.

I recommend him without hesitation.
A big thank you to Theo for his excellent advice and experience. Don't hesitate to contact him if you have any problems with your furry friend. Give Oslo a pat for you.

I contacted Théo shortly after adopting Winnie from the shelter because I needed guidance and to build a bond with her.

Théo is very attentive (to both the dog and the owner!) and patiently and kindly gave us the tools to teach basic commands. I recommend him 100%! :)

I'm a veterinary nurse, so I already had some theoretical knowledge that I wanted to expand upon with trainer Théo. The results exceeded my expectations. He's competent, but above all, he listens and adapts to the animals' needs. I highly recommend him, whether you're looking to deepen your training, like me, or just starting out.
Thank you so much, Théo!

Théo is a fantastic trainer! We contacted him after adopting our dog Tsuki from the shelter (she was 7 months old), mainly for help with her being alone, socializing her with other dogs and people, and basic training. He was very available, able to adapt to Tsuki's timid nature, and gave us lots of great advice.
A trainer who listens to animals. Highly recommended; Diva was a big fan of his.

We contacted Théo for our dog Lia, whom we adopted as an adult and who was reactive with other dogs. Thanks to his advice and the various training sessions, Lia has made tremendous progress, and we now enjoy our walks together. He also showed us other exercises to keep her occupied and mentally stimulated, which she loves! Théo knows his subject inside and out and approaches different issues calmly and serenely, which is very reassuring. His dog Oslo also assisted him during a session; he's an adorable and very well-behaved dog!

In short: don't hesitate and go for it! :)

My little corgi and I would like to warmly thank Théo for everything he taught us (especially me!) and for all the qualities that make him such an excellent trainer. Almost every week, depending on the class dates, we were able to progress under his kind, patient, and generous guidance (no exaggeration). There was never any judgment or condemnation; we went in with complete confidence and went home feeling a sense of accomplishment and peace of mind. He's a trainer who listens, understands, and gives advice, and we'll miss our classes. We highly recommend him!

Thank you for everything, Théo. It was very informative, and we're making sure to apply what you taught us. Our latest exercise is already paying off!

Until next time!
Go learn with Théo! It's a pleasure to feel understood without judgment and with kindness. Umy has made progress, there's still more to learn, but we're moving forward together.

As a family, we benefited from five training sessions for our first dog, who was four months old. Théo listened carefully to our questions and provided us with many relevant tips, giving us the foundation for positive and consistent …

I highly recommend taking lessons with Theo. Very competent, attentive to our needs (as well as our dog's), a skilled teacher, and using a gentle, kind, and understanding method, he helped us to much better understand and address our dog's …

I own a 10-month-old Australian Shepherd named Moca. We called Théo for barking problems during meals and with recall. Théo was fantastic, using positive reinforcement training, always offering good advice, available, and a great listener. I highly recommend him.
I started classes with Théo shortly after getting my two-and-a-half-month-old puppy. The classes went really well and helped both my dog ​​and me develop good behavior (well, mostly me, haha). …

Theo is fantastic! He listened to our needs and Moca loved him. He has a great rapport with animals and tailors each session to our needs. Thank you so much 🙏 and we highly recommend him! …
